name: Arcane Orders
worldbuilding: Magical academies, wizard kingdoms, enchanted soldiers, and construct armies supported by specialized arcane machinery. Their forces combine organized magical firepower with battlefield manipulation.

factionCommands.name: Overchannel
factionCommands.effect: The active Unit’s next Spell Attack this Assault Phase gains +1 Damage. This changes Damage per successful unsaved Hit, not the number of Attacks; it does not affect a second Attack.

factionCommands.name: Counterspell
factionCommands.effect: Reaction: When a friendly Unit is targeted by an enemy Magic Attack or ability that allows Armor, Evade, or Ward Saves, reroll up to all natural 1s in that Unit's applicable Save roll against the triggering effect. Each die may be rerolled at most once. This does not change Saves that the effect does not permit.

factionCommands.name: Spatial Fold
factionCommands.effect: During its own Movement activation, the active unengaged Unit gains Blink 3 and may immediately reposition up to 3" following normal Blink rules, ending legally and unengaged. This does not count as a normal Move or grant another activation.

factionCommands.name: Disjoin the Formation
factionCommands.effect: For the active Unit's next eligible Attack this Phase, choose one of these battlefield-role counters: Anti-Elite 4 or Anti-Monster 4. The active Unit gains the selected Anti-tag 4 for its next eligible Attack against a Unit actually bearing the matching tag this Round. Applicable Anti ranks never add; use the highest. This is one CP-powered Command and cannot stack with another friendly Command on the same Attack.

abilities.name: Spell Shield
abilities.effect: This Unit gains Tough 1 against Magic Attacks.

abilities.name: Waymark
abilities.effect: During this Unit's Movement activation, after its normal Move, spend 1 CP to place one 25mm Waymark token within 6" of this Unit and more than 3" from enemies. Only its own Waymark may be used; replace any previous Waymark. Cannot place a Waymark from Reserve or in the Round this Unit arrives from Reserve.

abilities.name: Fold Step
abilities.effect: After Scoring, if this Unit is not Engaged and has an active Waymark, it may Blink to it: remove the token, place one leading Model centered on the token's former position, then place all remaining Models in legal Coherency. Ignore intervening terrain but obey normal Blink placement, elevation and Engagement restrictions. If legal placement is impossible, remain in place. Remove any unused Waymark at the end of the Round. This does not cause a Charge, grant an activation, or score objectives retroactively.

signatureCoreUnits.name: Aether Ballista Team

abilities.name: Anchored Array
abilities.effect: Ignore Cover when resolving the Ballista Attack.

signatureCoreUnits.note: The Aether Ballista Team counts as Ranged Infantry, not Artillery. Its two Models attack individually, and losing one Model halves its Attack dice.

abilities.name: Arcane Binding
abilities.effect: Immune to Slow and forced-movement effects.

abilities.name: Resonant Blades
abilities.effect: While this Unit is within Short of a different friendly Wizard Unit, Stone Fists improve Hit from 5+ to 4+. This is a conditional Hit improvement and does not add extra Attacks or ranks of Accurate.

abilities.name: Disrupting Strike
abilities.effect: Target one unit within Short of this unit. That unit cannot use personal Command Abilities until the end of the Phase.

abilities.name: Flash Step
abilities.effect: Blink 3. Reposition this unit within 3" of its original position before the activation of this Ability.

abilities.name: Arcane Mastery
abilities.effect: When a Spell Attack Surges, one target suffers Direct Damage 1 after resolving the Attack.

abilities.name: Spell Cascade
abilities.effect: After another nearby friendly Unit resolves a Spell Attack, one different friendly Unit within Short gains Critical 1 on its next Spell Attack this Round.

abilities.name: Flash Step
abilities.effect: Blink 3. Reposition this unit within 3" of its original position before the activation of this Ability.

abilities.name: Power Cores
abilities.effect: One friendly Construct, Artillery, or Ranged Infantry Unit within Short may use one Heavy Magic Attack after moving, but worsens Hit by one step.

optionalUpgrades.name: Specialized Guidance
optionalUpgrades.effect: At list construction choose one existing creature/material Trait tag. Other friendly Units wholly within 3" gain Anti-[that tag] 2. Highest applicable Anti rank only. This is a passive aura, not a free Command; does not benefit its source.

abilities.name: Arcane Shield
abilities.effect: Nearby friendly units in Short of this unit gain Ward 6+ or improve their existing Ward +1 against Magic Attacks.

abilities.name: Ley-Line Surge
abilities.effect: Before firing, may gain +1 Damage; on a Blunder, suffer Direct Damage 1.

upgrades.name: Ley-Line Rupture
upgrades.effect: Instead of making a Ley Lance Attack, place a 25mm token within 16". At the end of the Combat Phase, every Unit with at least half its surviving Models (rounded up) within 2" of the token suffers two automatic Magic Hits at Damage 1 total. Resolve Armor then Ward; no Evade. Resolve Saves normally. Remove the token after resolving the effect.

factionLeader.name: Grand Magus

abilities.name: High Thaumaturgy
abilities.effect: Once per Round, reduce the CP cost of an Ability of a model within Medium of this model by 1. This only applies to the first ability you have used this turn.

abilities.name: Supreme Arcana
abilities.effect: All allied units wholly within Short of this model gains Direct Damage 1 for each Surge they generate on a magical attack or Ability against a non-friendly model until the end of the turn.

abilities.name: Flicker Step
abilities.effect: Blink 6. Reposition this unit within 6" of its original location.

knownIssues: No printed Impact value, consistent with being a pure Wizard Hero rather than a melee/Charge-oriented Faction Leader — likely intentional, unlike the Archfiend/Pale Monarch omissions flagged elsewhere.

genericUnitsWorthTaking: Ordinary shield Infantry, cheaper Wizards, Medics, generic Ranged Infantry, and conventional Cavalry. The Aether Ballista is far more specialized than generic archers and loses substantial output to a single casualty.
designNotes: v4.2 balance pass: added Animated Guardians as the faction's Extra Core, a Construct Infantry unit immune to Control effects, reinforcing the 'construct armies' worldbuilding and Firing Line/Control doctrines rather than patching a weakness. Damage-1 weapons across the faction gained +1 Attack; Damage-2+ weapons kept their Attacks and gained a thematic Anti-[Type] (Anti-Armored on Bound Ballista and the Arcane Golem's Stone Fists, Anti-Monster on the Arcane Golem's Arcane Cannon, Anti-Elite on the Grand Magus' Celestial Discharge).
